name: Rebase lokal verifizieren
command: cd /tmp/t3code-sync-20260909 && set -o pipefail; (node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/web > /tmp/t3-sync-web-types.log 2>&1) & web=$!; (node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/server > /tmp/t3-sync-server-types.log 2>&1) & server=$!; (node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts > /tmp/t3-sync-contracts-types.log 2>&1) & contracts=$!; (cd apps/web && ../../node_modules/.bin/vp test run --project unit src/components/settings/AddProviderInstanceDialog.test.ts src/components/settings/AddProviderInstanceDialog.environment.test.tsx src/components/chat/ComposerPrimaryActions.test.tsx src/components/chat/ContextWindowMeter.logic.test.ts > /tmp/t3-sync-web-tests.log 2>&1) & webtests=$!; (cd apps/server && ../../node_modules/.bin/vp test run src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.integration.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiProvider.test.ts src/provider/Layers/PiRpcClient.test.ts > /tmp/t3-sync-server-tests.log 2>&1) & servertests=$!; failed=0; for item in "$web:web typecheck" "$server:server typecheck" "$contracts:contracts typecheck" "$webtests:web tests" "$servertests:server tests"; do pid=${item%%:*}; label=${item#*:}; if wait "$pid"; then echo "$label: passed"; else echo "$label: failed"; failed=1; fi; done; exit "$failed"
